The model assigns 82/100 and states "caregiver capacity is currently compromised" and "child's vulnerability is notably high" with "high immediate risk of recurrent harm." The model essentially ignores the documented exceptional progress and frames this as a high-risk case when the source documents present it as a low-risk situation with strong protective factors.
